bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
test -d "$r/.git" || test -f "$r/.git"
test "$(git -C "$r" remote get-url origin | sed 's#^.*github.com[:/]##;s#\.git$##')" = seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot
test -z "$(git -C "$r" status --porcelain -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py)"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
test -f "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session"
test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"
python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null
echo PROFILE_USERBOT_PRECHECK=PASS
